newsitem.title: INDIA: U.N. chief urges swift deployment of Albania force.
newsitem.headline: U.N. chief urges swift deployment of Albania force.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan on Monday called for the rapid deployment of a peacekeeping force in strife-torn Albania.
The United Nations Security Council endorsed the Italian-led security force for Albania in a record 11 hours on March 28, Annan said in a statement released in the Indian capital.
"As one who has been in charge of U.N. peacekeeping operations, I am keenly aware that, in these situations, speed is of the essence," he said.
"I would, therefore, hope that the multinational force led by Italy would be deployed rapidly and with the support and cooperation of all concerned."
Tirana, racked by weeks of banditry, looting and insurrection, has been urging the fastest possible action since the U.N. Security Council approved the force a week ago.
But Italy's foreign ministry said on Friday that the multinational force of up to 6,000 troops would not reach the Balkan country until April 14 at the earliest.
Annan was in New Delhi to address a meeting of the foreign ministers of the Non-Aligned Movement later on Monday.
